preconditions.description: The lengths of strings A and B match the given integers n and m.
The lengths of strings A and B are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in A)
preconditions.description: String A consists only of lowercase Latin letters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in B)
preconditions.description: String B consists only of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: return_value == max(4 * LCS(C, D) - len(C) - len(D) for C in substrings(A) for D in substrings(B))
postconditions.description: The output is the maximal similarity score over all pairs of substrings (C, D) from A and B.
